Product Features

  • Flexible height adjustment: This stylish coffee table offers optimal adaptability thanks to its height-adjustable tabletop. Easily adaptable to different situational needs – ideal for dining, working or as a storage area.
  • Integrated LED lighting: Equipped with an LED light strip that is controlled via a smartphone app via Bluetooth. Choose from thousands of colors, adjust brightness, and switch between dynamic modes to add ambience to any room.
  • Hidden storage: Below the liftable tabletop is a hidden storage space, perfect for storing home accessories or magazines close at hand but invisibly. This design maximizes the usable space efficiency of modern living spaces.
  • Sturdy Material & High Load Capacity: Made of high-quality chipboard material, this coffee table can support weights up to 50kg. Ideal for everyday use and versatile in your home.
  • European sockets integrated: Equipped with standardized EU sockets, this coffee table makes it easy to charge electronic devices and supports all common plug formats, reinforced by a CE certification that guarantees the highest safety standards.
  • Space-saving and functional: The modern, minimalist design of the table fits perfectly into any home décor while offering functional features such as hidden storage options and integrated sockets.
  • Simple and intuitive design: With its clean lines and simple white finish, the table fits seamlessly into any living situation and emphasizes the modern style of your interior.
  • Energy-efficient LED technology: The LED strip built into the table is not only a visual eye-catcher, but also energy-efficient, which minimizes energy consumption and contributes to the sustainability of your home.
